passage:
Archaeologists found part of an ancient road under a modern street. It was made of stones placed carefully together.
Local shops worried that digging would hurt business. Historians argued that the road should be studied before the street was repaired.
The city created a glass-covered section in the sidewalk so people could see part of the old road while still walking safely above it.
The solution was not perfect, but it connected past and present.
People hurry through cities every day, rarely thinking about what lies below. The ancient road reminded them that modern life is often built on layers of earlier footsteps.
